listing.description:
The workout tracker featured by Apple and trusted by 15M+ lifters. Rated 4.9 on the App Store. 112M+ workouts logged in 2025 alone.

Log every set, follow any program or split, and track your lifts and volume. Learn how to do any exercise with high-quality videos and step-by-step instructions. Free, with no ads.

Train alongside millions of lifters, follow friends and family, compare your stats, and share your progress in their feed.

No program? No problem. Whether you're new and overwhelmed or a gym veteran, browse Hevy's large, free library for a full split or individual workouts.

And now, Hevy Trainer gives you the coaching you need, available with Hevy Pro. It builds a program tailored to your experience, goal, available equipment, and preferences. Trainer tracks your progress and consistency, and guides you through each workout with tips and progressive overload. (Even if you only have dumbbells and a workout mat.)

WHY HEVY?
• Log weights, reps, duration, and RPE in seconds without breaking the flow of your sets.
• See last session's weights and reps for every exercise, right where you need them. No guessing, no scrolling back through history.
• Log supersets, drop sets, warm-ups, and failure sets alongside your regular sets.
• Stay on track with automatic rest timers between sets.
• Monitor your strength progression and PRs with graphs for every exercise.
• Add progress photos, body weight, and measurements to see how your training is paying off.
• Follow friends and athletes from around the world, see their workouts in your feed, and compare your lifts.
• Stay consistent with monthly, yearly, and multi-year calendars and streak tracking.
• Work out offline. Your data syncs across all your devices.
• Automatically sync your workouts to Strava for hybrid training.

APPLE WATCH
• Log sets, start rest timers, and finish your workout without touching your phone.
• Monitor your heart rate during your workout.
• Add Hevy complications to your watch face.
• Workouts save automatically when your watch reconnects to your phone.

Hevy uses HealthKit and CareKit to export your workouts to the Health app. You can turn this on in Settings.

WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING
"Hevy blends workout tracking with social motivation, making it a top pick if you thrive on accountability and community support." Men's Journal
"By far my favorite workout tracking app." The Morning Show Podcast
"I've experimented with enough strength training apps that I know which ones are out there, and I definitely have a favorite: It's Hevy." Beth Skwarecki, senior health editor, Lifehacker

Whether you work out at home or at the gym, want to build muscle or lose fat, train twice a week or every day, Hevy is the last workout tracker you'll ever need. Give it a try.

HEVY PRO
• Hevy Trainer: a program and ongoing guidance based on your experience, goal, available equipment, and preferences.
• Unlimited routines and custom exercises.
• Your complete training history.

If you choose to purchase Hevy Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off automatic renewal at any time in your Apple account settings. You have the right to withdraw from your initial subscription within 14 days of starting it. If you don't purchase Hevy Pro, you can keep using Hevy for free.
